correctness.rationale: The two singleton and full Nyström approximations and the 2x2 VFE objective give explicit exact determinant and inverse formulas, whose difference equals the asserted B(r)-C(r)a^2. The positive threshold follows from f(0)=0 and f'(t)>1/3; Taylor expansion proves weak-correlation failure and leading observation coefficients yield zero uniform weak-submodularity ratio. Exact rational matrix algebra was independently reconstructed in 2170 test instances using the actual included script, which returned VERIFY_OK. These finite cases are verification of formulas, not proof over a continuum. All universal claims follow from the displayed analytic proof; 0<r<1 and a>=0 boundaries are explicit.

value.rationale: The natural exact two-site inducing-set selection task has a complete necessary-and-sufficient diminishing-returns phase, including an attained threshold rather than a cheap isolated negative sign. For any fixed nonzero output amplitude the failure exists at arbitrarily weak correlation (near identity), and the submodularity ratio can vanish across instances, identifying concrete limits on unconditional greedy pivot guarantees. No approximation guarantee or broader algorithmic effect is claimed.
